summary: Iteration 2 testing — focused on NEW features: /api/waitlist (idempotent), /api/admin/* (token-gated), legal pages (/privacy, /terms, /dpdp), env-driven DownloadButtons 'Coming Soon' state, hero+CTA waitlist forms, /admin SPA console. All 19 backend tests passed (test_contact_api updated to drop removed GET /api/contact + new file test_waitlist_admin_api.py). All frontend flows passed end-to-end against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: waitlist insert wraps insert_one in try/except but does NOT wrap the find_one upsert path — if mongo is down on the read, it surfaces as a 500 (acceptable). Consider adding a unique index on (email, role) in waitlist_signups to make idempotency race-safe under concurrent submits.
Admin.jsx: tokens are stored in localStorage in plaintext — acceptable for shared admin secret but worth flagging. Consider sessionStorage or never persisting (memory only) for higher security.

DownloadButtons.jsx: when href is empty, target/rel are stripped which is correct; minor nit — using href='#' still causes the URL hash to update visually on some browsers despite preventDefault. Confirmed during test that URL did NOT change, so functionally OK.
WaitlistForm.jsx: city select default is hard-coded to 'Delhi' — if a user doesn't change it, every signup defaults to Delhi. Consider an empty 'Select city' placeholder option.
seed_data_creation: Test runs created multiple TEST_-prefixed contacts and waitlist entries (TEST_wl_, TEST_idem_, TEST_role_, TEST_admin_, TEST_adminwl_, TEST_e2e_, e2e_hero_*, e2e_cta_*) in test_database mongo. Not auto-cleaned.
